name: @ayni/api-qa
description: Colección Postman y ejecución con Newman de las pruebas de la API de Ayni

scripts.test:dev: newman run collections/ayni-api.postman_collection.json -e environments/dev.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/dev-junit.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/dev-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Ayni API · dev"
scripts.test:smoke:dev: newman run collections/ayni-api.postman_collection.json -e environments/dev.postman_environment.json --folder 00-Framework --folder Smoke --folder 09-Operational --reporters cli,junit --reporter-junit-export reports/dev-smoke-junit.xml
scripts.test:prd: newman run collections/ayni-api.postman_collection.json -e environments/prd.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/prd-junit.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/prd-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Ayni API · prd"
